question: Can an additional bounded second of unchanged support-transfer control complete the fourth walking cycle after the retained upright recovery?

evidence_basis.component_observation: R10R completes direct upright rise and 60-sample standing, then three walking cycles. Both exposed refusals are later rear-left preparation timeouts.
evidence_basis.causality_limits: The histories are descriptive and not a matched controller comparison. No continued physical trajectory or success beyond command 240 is known.

controller_change.limit_semantics: Permit up to 360 unreleased preparation commands; next non-ready command refuses with unchanged zero-actuation semantics. Six consecutive ready samples release under the existing ordering, including the existing boundary-release behavior.
controller_change.memory_validation: Only the new policy accepts its own preparation counter through 360. All old policies, old memory schemas and 240-command validation/refusals stay exact.

budget_rationale: 360 adds one second (50 percent) to a preparation budget whose observed positive margin is only two commands. The hard 1600-command walking limit is preserved: extra preparation time competes with the rest of the declared task instead of extending the finite acceptance horizon. A successor can still fail that outer bound.

alternatives.option: Repeat R10R or reinterpret its three cycles
alternatives.reason: The first single is consumed and incomplete; its original outcome and four-cycle contract stay fixed.

alternatives.option: Lower margin or consecutive ready dwell
alternatives.reason: Would weaken the stability requirement that has not yet been met.

alternatives.option: Increase feedback gain or alter reference-height dynamics
alternatives.reason: Changes physical actuation throughout preparation; the exposed comparison does not establish which gain or height law would improve stability.

alternatives.option: Increase only the new policy preparation limit to 360
alternatives.reason: Addresses the demonstrated tight time allowance while preserving the controller and existing finite task horizon. It must be tested prospectively.

alternatives.option: Repeat the full 360-phase startup sweep before investigating later balance
alternatives.reason: Startup-only enumeration does not observe this later physical preparation. New-runtime qualification must cover affected boundaries and exact unchanged startup geometry without treating synthetic phases as physical states.

required_coverage: Original native policy outputs and both retained terminal refusals reproduce byte-exactly on their original IDs.

All six exposed walking histories are checked on the new policy using copied inputs and prospectively translated memory IDs: completed command arithmetic, caps, contacts and stop outputs retain the predecessor values apart from explicit identity fields.

Synthetic exact boundary checks cover counters 239, 240, 241, 359, 360 and invalid 361, including readiness release, non-ready refusal, fresh memory, stale clocks, crossed policy memory and stateless/session equality.
The actual Godot adapter and independent reader reject crossed policy IDs, limits, memory, finalization and publication identities.
Original R10R upright and Q/partial/prone API fixtures remain exact; no recovery law changes.
Production launcher enforces declared roles, explicit prefix phases, complete gate, clean pushed source, single-use initial consumption, process ownership, bounded stepping and no-claim publication.
qualification.qualification_reuse: Only exact complete dependency-key matches permit reused evidence. Source-level reasoning or copied test names do not waive affected native and adapter checks.

first_diagnostic.question: Fresh upright recovery, V56 walking through all four cycles, and the complete stop on the exposed difficult phase.
first_diagnostic.coverage_adequacy: The new behavior begins at an existing support-preparation deadline. The first fresh kicked child exercises that deadline after the retained upright path. Both roles receive real-interface safety coverage first; this single makes no paired-effect claim.

development_coverage.if_first_not_valid_positive: Retain the consumed result; no later R10S pair or additional cell may launch. Any further change requires a distinct successor.

if_first_valid_positive.if_pair_not_valid_positive: Close this R10S development chain; no additional cells or held-out population.

risks: Additional time may still never produce six consecutive ready samples.
More preparation can exhaust the unchanged 1600-command walking budget.
Later foot placement, stop settling, and the partial/prone branches can fail independently of upright recovery.
Two observed timeouts and four successes cannot establish robustness or acceptance probability.
